name: allocation-review
title: Cost allocation review pack
for_each: select id,code from periods order by code

sections.title: Pool basis and evidence
sections.sql: select code,name,cost_cents,unit,owner,review_due,evidence,unallocated_cents from v_pool_review where period_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Measured activity
sections.sql: select pool,object,quantity,allocated_cents from v_allocations where period_id=$1 order by pool,object

sections.title: Customer contribution
sections.sql: select code,name,segment,revenue_cents,direct_cents,overhead_cents,contribution_cents from v_margins where period_id=$1 order by contribution_cents
sections.note: Contribution excludes overhead that has no measured activity. Read reconciliation and resolve unallocated cost before sign-off.

sections.title: Calculations and recorded sign-offs
sections.sql: select r.id,r.revision,r.operator,r.created_at,s.operator signed_by,s.reason from runs r left join signatures s on s.run_id=r.id where r.period_id=$1 order by r.created_at

name: customer-cost-statement
title: Internal customer cost statement
for_each: select id,code from objects order by code

sections.title: Customer and period
sections.sql: select o.code,o.name,o.segment,p.code period,p.currency,o.evidence from objects o join periods p on p.id=o.period_id where o.id=$1

sections.title: Contribution
sections.note: Contribution excludes overhead that has no measured activity. Read reconciliation and resolve unallocated cost before sign-off.

sections.title: Activity allocation detail
sections.sql: select pool,quantity,allocated_cents from v_allocations where object_id=$1 order by pool
